_how_to_update: Optional. Once a month, copy the average forecast from the IRI plume (https://iri.columbia.edu/our-expertise/climate/forecasts/enso/current/) or the NOAA RONI outlook into 'values', keyed by season exactly as the dashboard shows it (e.g. 'SON 2026'). Leave 'values' empty to hide the dots. Note: IRI forecasts the traditional Nino3.4 index, which runs a little different from RONI.
